mapper.select: SELECT dqlr.dates, dqlr.pkg, dqlr.source_type, COUNT(distinct dqlr.user_id) active_user_num, SUM(dqlr.event_ltv) + ROUND(SUM(IFNULL(SUBSTRING(event, LOCATE('_', event) + 1, LOCATE('.', event) - LOCATE('_', event) - 1), 0)) / #{singleFee}, 8) active_event_ltv, SUM(dqlr.user_ltv) active_user_ltv, COUNT(distinct dui.user_id) new_user_num, SUM(IF(dui.user_id IS NOT NULL, dqlr.event_ltv, 0)) + ROUND(SUM(IF(dui.user_id IS NOT NULL, IFNULL( SUBSTRING(event, LOCATE('_', event) + 1, LOCATE('.', event) - LOCATE('_', event) - 1), 0), 0)) / #{singleFee}, 8) new_user_event_ltv, SUM(IF(dui.user_id IS NOT NULL, dqlr.user_ltv, 0)) new_user_ltv FROM dwd_qp_ltv_record dqlr LEFT JOIN dim_user_info dui on (dui.user_id = dqlr.user_id and dui.dates = dqlr.dates) where dqlr.dates = #{dates} GROUP BY dqlr.dates, dqlr.pkg, dqlr.source_type
